free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the convergence of high-risk imaging and rising biochemical markers. The evidence is driven by the PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone and the significant PSA velocity of 1.13 ng/mL/yr, which strongly contradicts the initial statistical prior. The combination of a PI-RADS 4 finding and a rising PSA trend justifies further tissue sampling in this context.
